Principles of Art and Design

This module introduces the principles of art and design through the lens of game production.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Apply visual research, moodboarding and concept-development techniques to generate ideas that fit a defined theme.

+  Execute digital painting and 3D workflows using industry-standard software to produce resolved visual concepts and a built game asset.

+  Explain visual designs in relation to their purpose and placement within a game development pipeline.

+  Reflect honestly on the process: what worked, what was challenging, what you would do differently, and what you learned about visual development and the pipeline.
